I lived in Sao Paulo for forty years.
Last winter I got completely fed up with the traffic.
My dogs sleep in the backyard every afternoon.
Right now they are barking at the mailman.
Ana, right? We were in the same session yesterday. I am Daan.
Yes! Nice to meet you properly. Are you calling from Amsterdam?
No, actually. I moved away from Amsterdam two years ago. I live in a village now.
Really? I have done the same thing. I left Sao Paulo in 2021.
So you know how it is. Everybody told us we would be bored.
And? Have you been bored?
Not once. I was completely fed up with the commute. Now I walk to my desk.
That is exactly my story. I have never regretted it.
I grew up in Sao Paulo, but I have lived in the countryside since 2021.
I moved away because I was fed up with the commute.
I have never regretted it, not for one day.
Have you ever lived outside a big city?
Sorry, could you say that again a little more slowly?

I have lived in four different cities, and honestly, the last move was the one that changed everything. I grew up in a big place, full of traffic and rush hour and noise. For years I told myself that the pace of life was normal. Then one winter I got completely fed up with the commute. Two hours in the morning, two hours at night. So we sold the apartment and moved to a small town near the mountains. That was six years ago. I have never regretted it, not for a single day. My neighbours know my name. I can hear birds instead of car horns. People ask me if I miss the city, and the honest answer is no. I miss some restaurants. I do not miss the life.

Hello Ana, this is Daan. Sorry I could not join the call this morning. I wanted to say it was really nice to meet you last week. You asked me where I grew up, and I did not answer properly, so here it is. I grew up in a very small village, about three thousand people, in the north of the country. I moved to the city when I was nineteen, for university, and I stayed there for almost fifteen years. Two years ago my wife and I moved back to the countryside. Everybody told us we would be bored. We have not been bored once. Talk soon.
